definition-dropped.answer: The rule's 'type' is 'the type of record locking' (a kind of locking), not the type that §2002:4 defines for a type declaration ('A template that contains all the characteristics of a data item and its subordinates', the same words as §2023:8.5.3.1); the dropped definition cannot change which programs the rule governs.

pending-clause.answer: Invoked only by the word 'type'. §2002:8.5.3 (TYPEDEF types), §2002:8.5.4 (zero-length items) and §2002:14.5.8 (alignment of data in a receiving item) do not bear on record locking or the SHARING clause; the rule does not rest on their 2002 text, and the evidence already shown at --std 2002 stands.
